most_similar_reason: Candidate 8 is essentially the same epic: a great god incarnating as a prince to destroy a demon king, winning a princess at a bow/archery contest, exile to the forest with a loyal brother, the spurned demoness, the abduction of the wife, alliance with monkeys and settling their kingship dispute, a devoted monkey ally who finds her, and the final defeat of the demon king and return home.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 9 is a bare identification of a deity with no narrative, figures, or events at all, so it shares nothing beyond the existence of a god.
